_about: AIMEAT desktop default — every crew runs FULLY LOCAL on Ollama (no API keys, offline). The desktop drops this file into the crewaimeat working directory on first run (as llm_providers.json). gemma3 is the primary model (the newest Gemma on Ollama today; swap to gemma4 once it lands on Ollama). qwen2.5:7b is a local fallback because it is stronger at tool-calling, which the AIMEAT crews lean on. To use a stronger cloud model for harder (e.g. coding) crews, add an OpenRouter/xAI provider AFTER the local one, or switch to the per-crew 'profiles' format — see llm_providers.example.json in the crewaimeat repo.
